regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, graphical abstract, and SI marker
regions.finding: Article identity and the aggregate two-alkyne/pyrrolidine/CdI2 transformation were inspected. The SI marker states availability, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI facts were used.

Equations 1 and 2 are explicitly previous ATA work and were classified as two literature examples. Equation 3 is the generic current transformation and was classified as a general scheme; no experiment-specific yield was assigned to it.

regions.region: page 1 upper-right Scheme 2 equations 4–5 and adjacent prose
regions.finding: Two current experiments were retained separately: 1-octyne/hexan-3-one/pyrrolidine gives 4a (12% NMR) plus unexpected 3a (64% NMR), while omission of ketone with 2.2 equiv pyrrolidine/1.6 equiv CdI2 gives 3a in 80% NMR yield.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Scheme 3 and cross-page mechanism discussion
regions.finding: Species 4–9 form a proposed hydroamination/ketoniminium/propargylic-amine/1,5-hydride-transfer/β-elimination mechanism and were not treated as isolated preparations.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits alkyne scale, toluene volume, atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, and NMR internal standard.
Generic Scheme 1/3 structures remain label-only where R groups are unspecified.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left mechanism continuation and optimization prose
regions.finding: The text completes the proposed Scheme 3 explanation and maps the stated 1-decyne/pyrrolidine/CdI2 quantities to Table 1 rather than creating a duplicate narrative experiment.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–9, and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine independent loading/concentration optimization rows were retained with 1 mmol 1b, row-specific pyrrolidine/CdI2 equivalents, 130 °C/4 h, CH3NO2-based NMR yields, and concentration overrides for entries 8–9. Their row-specific solvent volumes were not inferred from concentration.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–6, footnotes, and adjacent prose
regions.finding: Six independent metal-salt screens were retained. Product-specific NMR yields for 3b and 7b remain separate; printed dashes are not zeros. Visual inspection confirms the HgCl2 row as 3b=0 and 7b=9. The CuI Glaser-type product is explicitly not detected.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 3 reaction header, entries 1–9, footnotes, and scope prose
regions.finding: Nine alkyl-substituted terminal-alkyne scope experiments were retained with shared 1 mmol/1.6 equiv/1.0 equiv/2 mL/130 °C/4 h conditions and isolated yields. The separately stated dodec-11-ynoic-acid failure was retained as its own standard-condition experiment.
The prose introduces six aromatic-alkyne experiments drawn on page 3; page-2 optimized quantities are linked as cross-page evidence rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Table 1 entries 8–9 do not print row-specific toluene volumes despite concentration overrides.
Tables 1–3 omit atmosphere, workup, purification, and most product masses.
Functionalized allene product structures remain label-only when the compact common template was insufficient for confident encoding.

regions.finding: Six distinct aromatic-alkyne scope rows 1j–o were retained with their displayed substituent structures, row temperatures/times, and 39/43/27/18/32/43% isolated yields under shared CdI2/pyrrolidine/toluene conditions.

regions.region: page 3 left-center Scheme 5 and mechanism-support prose
regions.finding: Two experiments were retained separately: low-temperature capture of 7m (34% isolated) with 3m (9% NMR), and conversion of isolated 7m with CdI2/toluene to 3m (28% isolated) with 10% recovered 7m.
A distinct 10 mmol gram-scale 1b experiment uses 1.4108 g substrate, 1.6 equiv pyrrolidine and 1.0 equiv CdI2 at 130 °C for 4 h, affording 1.0335 g 3b in 74% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 3 conclusions, Associated Content, acknowledgments, and references 1–6
regions.finding: Conclusions add no experiment. The SI statement does not establish a supplied association. Reproduction of Table 3 entries 2/8 and Scheme 4 product 3k supplies provenance only and no separate conditions/outcomes, so no duplicate runs were created. Remaining content is bibliography.

unresolved: Scheme 5 omits some scales, solvent volumes, workups, purifications, masses, and the NMR internal standard.
Scheme 6 omits toluene volume, atmosphere, workup, and purification.
Acknowledged reproductions do not define separable runs.
